propositions: Truncated bridge-echo comments lacking the reconciler marker exist across three Jira issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) and must be cleaned up as Phase 2 of duplicate removal
The marker is missing because it is appended after the body, so 32767-character truncation removes it before storage
Duplicates are identified by presence of truncation suffix AND absence of marker, and kept-one rule keeps the oldest comment per distinct normalized body
Phase 2 successfully deleted 827 duplicate comments (138+276+414) across the three issues with zero data loss, verified by backup reconciliation
After bridge re-enablement, the keep-one rule must invert to preserve the newest comment recorded in comment_ids map, otherwise id-references will orphan and recreate the original defect
